messages:
indra: Quick heads-up — releasebot just auto-bumped a patch for a staging-only config tweak (0.18.6 -> 0.18.7). Should we treat config-only changes as bump-noops during sprint cut windows?

sam: Ugh, this churn is noisy. I'd prefer not to create stable patches for purely config/docs/infra edits unless we actually need a hotfix.

releasebot: Automated bump: tag created v0.18.7 (reason: ci/deploy/staging.yml change). If this was unintended, you can run `/releasebot revert-tag v0.18.7` or `/releasebot pin 0.18.6` to lock stable.

maya: For context, last time a config-only patch hit stable we had to update a downstream pin. Small but annoying. Proposal: annotate and queue config-only changes for a Friday rollup instead of immediate patch bump.

kevin: I like queueing. Also we should make clear when we *must* bump: anything touching runtime code, public API, or migration SQLs. Otherwise tag as `meta:config` and skip bump.

mike: Concrete rule suggestion:
```
if changed_paths matches ^(deploy|infra|docs|tools)/ then
  add label queued-patch and dont-bump
else
  normal bump rules
```
This avoids silent behavior changes.

sam: Could releasebot add heuristics so we don't need manual triage? e.g., files-only in `infra/`/`docs/` => annotate; config in `configs/runtime.yml` => bump (because it changes behavior).

indra: Yeah I can add a small matcher. Two follow-ups: (1) how do we handle rollback/pinning if a queued batch unexpectedly breaks something? (2) change-window semantics for active sprints.

kevin: For rollback: still support `/releasebot pin <version>` to freeze stable and `/releasebot rollback <tag>` to revert. For queued batches we should have a canary channel and auto-rollback on error threshold.

maya: For sprint cuts: we should have a `sprint-freeze` flag on releasebot that toggles auto-bump => annotate. Ops can flip it before cut, flip back after merge window opens. Less ad-hoc noise.

mike: Agreed. Also add a release-note field for queued patches so when Friday rollup goes out we can generate changelog entries automatically: include `queued-patch: true` and source PRs.

indra: I'll open a tiny RFC and a follow-up PR to releasebot config with the matcher + `sprint-freeze` flag. Draft plan in comments.

sam: :thumbsup: one more ask — can we add a deploybot check that warns when a PR will auto-bump stable during freeze? A pre-merge CI check that prints `BUMP_X` label if bump will occur.

releasebot: Note: canary deployments already skip queued-batch behavior; rollout settings unaffected.

mike: TL;DR for ops playbook: 1) config-only => annotate/queue; 2) infra/docs => no auto-patch; 3) add /releasebot pin/unpin commands to standard runbook; 4) Friday rollup generates changelog from queued labels. I'll add those to the ops doc once RFC lands.

indra: OK — I'll create the RFC and wire the rule into releasebot. Thanks all.
